credentials.why: PDR2 science coadds need a STARS account. Everything PDR2 serves without one is HiPS, which carries no calibrated flux and no variance plane, which is why this survey contributed 162 regions to the goal's footprint count and zero to reality.

reproducibility: A third party cannot re-run this fetch without their own PDR2 account. The per-region SHA-256 checksums let them verify what was fetched even so.
